href="/odds/futures/">2026 Futures Betting Odds</a></li> </ul> <h2 class="wp-block-heading">College Football Las Vegas Odds: NCAAF Spreads, Totals, &amp; Moneylines</h2> <p>Every matchup is listed in order of&nbsp;<strong>Rotation</strong>,&nbsp;and those numbers are preceded by the&nbsp;<strong>Date</strong>&nbsp;and&nbsp;<strong>Time</strong>&nbsp;of the College Football game.</p> <p>The rotation for college football games typically lists them by scheduled starting time, which can lead to confusion since the number will remain the same even if the games change due to television networks often shifting around action to present more attractive matchups. Home teams are listed at the bottom and will, therefore, be your even-numbered squad.</p> <h3 class="wp-block-heading">NCAAF Spreads</h3> <p>The numbers next to the teams are called&nbsp;<strong>Spreads</strong>&nbsp;or&nbsp;<strong>Point-Spreads</strong>.</p> <p><strong>Favorites</strong>&nbsp;are the teams laying points, which is represented by a minus (-) sign. The team in the&nbsp;<strong>Underdog</strong>&nbsp;role is getting points, which is represented by the plus (+) symbol that you wouldn’t see on the board but would be represented next team onto you betting ticket or slip. You can add the spread to your team’s final score and have that edge throughout the game.</p> <p>If there is no favorite or underdog, the line is called&nbsp;<strong>pick’em</strong>&nbsp;and is represented by (PK). Winner takes it. The amount of points a team is favored by is set by oddsmakers on Sunday afternoons and that figure fluctuates throughout the week based on the amount of money coming in on bets.</p> <h3 class="wp-block-heading">NCAAF Over Unders</h3> <p>You’ll also find the&nbsp;<strong>Total</strong> next to <strong>Spread</strong>, representing what oddsmakers believe will be the combined number of points scored between the teams. That number also increases or decreases based on bets coming in on the&nbsp;<strong>Over or Under</strong>.</p> <h3 class="wp-block-heading">NCAAF Moneylines</h3> <p>Next to Spread, you will find Moneyline, a wager on which team will win the game outright, with no point spread needed.</p> <p>Use our <a href="https://www.vegasinsider.com/sportsbooks/espn/">ESPN BET promo code</a> today when you bet on college football!</p> <h2 class="wp-block-heading">How to Bet College Football Las Vegas Odds</h2> <p>The key to wagering successfully in college football spread betting is to decide early how many points you’re willing to lay with&nbsp;<strong>Favorites</strong>&nbsp;and to get in at the lowest possible spot.</p> <p>If you’re going to back the&nbsp;<strong>Underdog</strong>, make sure you’re getting the most points possible entering the game. The skill in this often requires you to forecast how a game will be wagered since we often see opening lines bet up over the course of the week due to the majority of the money coming in on the favorite.</p> <p>Of course, getting in too early can often backfire if a better number appears over the course of the week or if injuries that are typically not announced until coaches give status reports on Monday press conferences dramatically alter expectations. There’s also a big rush on betting action just before the kickoff of any game, which means you may be best off waiting until kickoff approaches to get the right number.</p> <p>Let's look at an example. Team A opened as an 11.5-point favorite and won 42-31 after Team B scored the game’s final touchdown with :48 left. Team B backers who got in early prevailed on that score, while Team A bettors who guessed wrong and got in too early caught a “bad beat.” Those who waited and laid only 10.5 points still cashed. Get in at the best number!</p> <p>The <a href="https://www.vegasinsider.com/sportsbooks/draftkings/promo/">DraftKings promo code</a> is your key to unlocking special promotions for betting on college football games all season long. You can use it during sign-up to get an awesome welcome bonus.</p> <h2 class="wp-block-heading">VegasInsider Open &amp; Consensus</h2> <h3 class="wp-block-heading">College Football Opening Line</h3> <p>Opening Lines in college football are typically set on Sunday afternoons in the current week, and you usually see immediate action cause line movement. The Spread is based on a rough projection of a score for every matchup, although oddsmakers have a good idea of what side the betting public will want to bet on and usually saddles that team with an additional point or three. The same goes for the Total, which projects the combined number of points expected in a contest.</p> <p>These numbers are based on simulations that take a number of statistical factors into account, in addition to baking in injuries, a home field advantage that is typically worth three points, and any other potential edges. Teams coming off&nbsp;<strong>bye weeks</strong>&nbsp;are usually given an edge thanks to increased preparation time and fresher bodies. Teams coming in on short rest or that have to travel out of their element typically find themselves penalized in a point spread.</p> <h3 class="wp-block-heading">VI Consensus College Football Line</h3> <p>When looking at the numbers over the course of the week, you’ll see constant line movement on our odds and matchup pages. You'll see different numbers representing the current lines at any given point in the week, from when the line opens until just before kickoff. Those may vary from one another since properties offer up their own lines, so VI’s Consensus Line represents the one that appears most commonly.</p> <p>The Total is also available on the VI Consensus line and similarly consists of the current betting line that is most frequently offered by our list of Las Vegas and Global sportsbooks.</p> <h2 class="wp-block-heading">Other Popular Betting Odds</h2> <p>Along with providing College Football Las Vegas Odds, VegasInsider is also the leader in betting numbers for the most popular sports that are wagered on in the United States.</p> <p>Those sports and the betting odds can be found below:</p> <ul class="wp-block-list"> <li><a href="https://www.vegasinsider.com/nfl/odds/las-vegas/">NFL Odds &amp; Betting Lines</a></li> <li><a href="https://www.vegasinsider.com/mlb/odds/las-vegas/">MLB Odds &amp; betting Lines</a></li> <li><a href="https://www.vegasinsider.com/nba/odds/las-vegas/">NBA Odds &amp; Betting Lines</a></li> <li><a href="https://www.vegasinsider.com/nhl/odds/las-vegas/">NHL Odds &amp; Betting Lines</a></li> <li><a href="https://www.vegasinsider.com/college-basketball/odds/las-vegas/">College Basketball Odds &amp; Betting Lines</a></li> <li><a href="https://www.vegasinsider.com/soccer/odds/las-vegas/">Soccer Odds &amp; Betting Lines</a></li> <li><a href="https://www.vegasinsider.com/wnba/odds/las-vegas/">WNBA Las Vegas Odds</a></li> <li><a href="https://www.vegasinsider.com/cfl/odds/las-vegas/">CFL Odds &amp; Betting Lines</a></li> <li><a href="https://www.vegasinsider.com/tennis/odds/futures/">Tennis Futures Betting Odds</a></li> </ul> <p>Betting on college football is always exciting, especially when you find the most optimal odds at the best sportsbooks.
